quizGuardRationale: Author judgments for independent assessment: direct ordinary-meaning/actual-label overlap, symmetric and nontransitive. No baseline declaration changed; new-new pairs need only one declaration.

撮影 guards 撮る photograph/film, 写す1588320:4 photograph/film, 写真1321900:1 photography, and 記録 record/log under visual recording. 写る is intransitive appearance, 映画 the finished movie and フィルム the material; not every image/media word is an activity synonym.

雑音 guards 音/物音/騒音 acoustic noise and independently 噂/批判 under its ordinary gossip/irresponsible-criticism sense. Insulting remarks 悪口 and the complaint/phrase label 文句 are not automatically synonyms of all unwanted criticism.

さっさと guards direct quick/prompt/brisk activity meanings, including 早い's actual quick/prompt meanings despite its early title, 急に2269050:1 rapidly/immediately, and ordinary efficient-progress/brisk meanings on the listed onomatopoeia. あわてる and あわただしい have direct hurried/quick action meanings, not merely a shared hurry theme.

早速 independently guards すぐに/直ちに immediate timing, 早い quick/prompt timing, 急に's immediately sense and はきはき1010090 promptly. Other brisk/speed words are not automatically guards of immediate onset merely through さっさと.
錆びる guards noun 錆 under the shared rust answer and 腐る1497800:2 ordinary corrosion, not merely oldness on 古い or every kind of physical deterioration.
座布団 guards 布団's actual1496890:2 round Zen cushion, not a blanket bedding/cushion identity or a thematic pair with 畳.

冷ます and 冷める form a direct cooling pair; each separately guards 冷える. 冷める also guards composed expression 冷静 and subsiding/calming 落ち着く1589220:2. Cold-state/touch/weather adjectives are not automatic cooling-action guards. 覚ます1206060:4 is 醒ます-only and is not misassigned to the actual 覚ます label; awakening and pampering/spoil uses are distinguished.

妨げる guards direct hindrance on じゃま/障害/差し支え and prevention on 防ぐ/止める/予防, including 止める1310670:3,4 beyond its machinery-led introduction and 障害's transitive-suru family. Generic 問題 and experiencing bother 迷惑 are not automatically obstructing an activity.
さようなら guards 別れ under farewell/parting and お先に under its actual farewell/leaving-first use, not its unrelated ahead/before senses. Missing さよなら/失礼 articles are not fabricated as guard targets.
サラリーマン has no occupation-theme clique: factory worker 工員, shop employee 店員, public employee 公務員 and office work 事務 are not by themselves the salaryman/office-worker meaning.
騒がしい guards actual noisy/commotion meanings on うるさい/騒ぐ/ざわざわ, not every busy/hectic schedule or abstract instability.

さわやか guards refreshment さっぱり/すっきり, 涼しい1554370:1 refreshing, 快適 pleasantness, 新鮮's fresh/refreshing impressions, and independently clear/fluent speech on はきはき/はっきり/ぺらぺら. New/fresh 新た is novelty, しゃきしゃき crisp/brisk is not automatically a pleasant refreshed impression, and 元気 is health/energy; no transitive refreshing clique is assumed.
算数 independently guards 計算 under1303930:2 calculation and 数学 under arithmetic/elementary mathematics. The existing 数 label number/amount and 数える count/enumerate do not simply name the whole subject.

三角 is the whole triangular shape, not the existing bare-corner 角 label. 酸性 has no acid/alkaline article targets in the captured existing labels; same-reading 賛成 and broad 化学 chemistry are not semantic equivalents.

Exact reused 再来月/再来週/再来年 retain all content, N4/N4/N5 levels and baseline declarations. Only the claimed source senses and existing component/backlink coverage are assessed, not a renewed whole-article baseline certification.
sourceAccessLimits: Seventeen new articles and three unchanged exact reuse articles cover N2:622-N2:641. Named community-list membership is not an official modern JLPT syllabus.

Four newly tracked primary N2 reciprocal pairs for new articles: 布/座布団, 団/座布団, 角/三角 and 算/算数. Three already-existing 再/after-next links support unchanged reused articles and are not included in the new-article pair total. All existing component reading rows preserved.
Missing primary 撮,影,錆,妨,騒,酸 remain metadata; kana-primary 爽やか has no primary kanji metadata and no new 爽 card. No missing kanji/stroke articles fabricated.

Raw source spelling/reading/gloss/entry remain separate from selected teaching. 錆 raw color gloss is not an invented principal sense; whole 布団 ateji is not a historical group derivation; conditional さようなら does not assert exclusively native etymology.

Sixteen public lookups yielded lexical containers; さっさと did not. Supplemental Kotobank rendering also lacked a definition. Public observations are original concise paraphrases, not copied full bodies.

No executed app quiz draws, measured frequency, native-speaker certification or exhaustive baseline rereview. Initial derivative removes only quizGuardRationale; remaining mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess.
